content:
I, as well as @Jiang Jiedong and @Lei Bichang , have just finished the formalization of Ramification Group Theory. Specifically, we have formalized the context of Chapter 4, Section 1 & 3 of Serre's book <Local fields>. Our work are based on the excellent work on Local Class Field done by @María Inés de Frutos Fernández and @Filippo A. E. Nuccio . Here is our repo's link: https://github.com/Akwardbro/RamificationGroup.
Our work is contained in the RamificationGroup folder. The principal results are organized across the following three directories:

  1. LowerNumbering： It contains the definition of lowernumbering ramification group, lower index function and the basic properties of them.
  2. HerbrandFunction: It contains the definition of the herbrand function, and the basic properties of them.
  3. UpperNumbering: It contains the definition of uppernumbering ramification group, the real version of herbrand function and some properties.
    What's more, The file Valuation/Extension.lean contains a simple extension lemma of ring, It's prop12 in Serre's book Chap3 Sec6.
    The other folders contains some useful lemmas. About valuation, polynomial, and some supplement lemma for Mathlib.
    We have just finished this work recently, so the code may appear somewhat disorganized at present. Some proofs are admittedly verbose, and some theorems are named ambiguously. It seems doesn't yet meet Mathlib's submission standards, so we haven't initiated a pull request.
    We would greatly appreciate any suggestions for improvement - whether structural optimizations, proof simplifications, or naming adjustments. Please feel free to contact us, or talk in the linked thread(even minor suggestions are welcome!). Any suggestions are appreciated.
    Additionally, as we're balancing other tasks, the process of submitting this to Mathlib may take considerable time. We welcome collaborators to help polish the code. If you're interested, welcome to contact us, or submit pull requests to our repository.
